help.start:
Hello! I can help you find torrents and track downloads.

1️⃣ Send a title or search query.
2️⃣ Open a result, check its size and sources, then press Download.
3️⃣ Open Downloads to see progress, pause, resume or delete.

🔔 I will notify you when a download finishes. Deleting the torrent and its files requires confirmation.

Commands are available from the Menu button beside the message field.
help.search:
🔎 Send a film or series title, or another search query.

Results appear five per page. Select a number, review the release, then press Download.
help.help:
🔎 /search — search instructions; you can also send a title.
📥 /downloads — progress, pause, resume and deletion.
📊 /status — download summary.
🩺 /health — bot and service checks, updated hourly.
🌐 /language — English / Русский.
👋 /start — quick guide.

Deleting torrents and files requires confirmation. Search supports sorting, quality/size filters and previews. If a button expires, search again or reopen /downloads. Download monitoring resumes after bot restarts.
search.coverage.unavailable: ⚠️ Search is temporarily unavailable: no sources responded successfully.
search.stale: This list has expired. Search again with /search.
search.searching: 👀 Searching… Indexers may take a moment.
search.unavailable: Search is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
search.timeout: Search timed out. Please try again.
search.superseded: A newer search is open. Use its results.
search.empty: Nothing found 😕 Try a more specific title or year.
search.partial_empty: The responding sources found no matches. Try searching again.
search.unknown_empty: No matches in the received response.
search.refine: Refine your query or try again later.
search.previous: Previous results remain available until their buttons expire.
search.filter_hint: Filters apply to fetched results; quality is inferred from the title.
search.filter_empty: No fetched results match these filters. Change or reset the filters.
search.check_before_retry: Check Downloads before trying again: the torrent may already have been added.
search.watch_uncertain: ⚠️ Notifications could not be confirmed. Check progress in Downloads.
search.watching: 🔔 I will notify you when the download finishes.
search.new_prompt: 🔎 Send a new query — a title and, optionally, a year.
search.edit_error: Could not update the message. Reopen /search; if you pressed Download, check /downloads first.
search.busy: ⏳ Please wait for the current search or addition to finish. Downloads and their controls remain available through /downloads.
search.restarting: The bot is restarting. Please try again in a minute.
search.job_failed: The request could not be completed. If you were adding a torrent, check /downloads first.
